For business

Give the busywork to an agent.

Inbox triage, scheduling, follow-ups, research: the work that eats a small team’s week, handled by agents your whole team can message.

What it handles

The work that slows a small team down.

None of it is hard. All of it takes time. An agent does the repetitive middle; your team touches the part that needs a person.

Inbox & Customer TriageSorts what needs you now, drafts the rest
Client Follow-upsPrepares check-ins so nobody slips through
Scheduling & RemindersSuggests slots, drafts confirmations
Research & Supplier LookupsCompares options into a short list
Meeting RecapsCaptures decisions and action items
Reports & SummariesPulls from your tools into a status update
Archie for Business

Agents your whole team can message.

A personal Archie agent answers one person: its owner. A business one answers everybody the owner lets in, and that is the whole difference between the editions. Each person is answered from their own mail and calendar, never anybody else’s.

It installs beside the personal Archie as its own app, with its own data and keys. The full plan, side by side with the personal one.

The other way: an agent per person

Or an agent per teammate, all in the same app.

Some teams want a desk per person instead of one shared desk. The same app does that: an agent per teammate, shaped to their role, beside the one everybody shares.

Shaped to each role

Support gets an agent that triages the inbox and drafts replies. The owner gets one that chases follow-ups and preps the weekly numbers. Each asks about the business, then fits its Add-ons: Skills it can use, Routines it runs on a schedule, a Personality it answers in.

We never hold your conversations

Customer lists, invoices, inboxes: your business data stays on your computer. Agents reach the AI company on your own account, except on the starter credits a new install begins with, which end when you connect your own. Our servers hold each account’s email address, plan, and paid add-ons: never a conversation. The whole list is on the Trust page.

It can’t email your customers or spend your money

Archie can draft and send email and change a connected calendar, but only after you approve that exact action: it proposes, you approve. It has no ability to spend money or make a purchase; that doesn’t exist in the app. An agent speaks only in the chats you connect, to the people the owner lets in.

And if Archie can’t do it yet, tell us and we’ll build the add-on. It becomes a marketplace listing, so the one we build for you helps the next business.

Business Roadmap

Don’t know where to start? That’s the part we do with you.

Most owners don’t need convincing that some of this would help. They need to know which parts, in what order. That is the roadmap, in two steps.

First, the free discovery call

30 minutes, free, no commitment. We learn how the business runs and answer your questions, including what’s feasible. The recommendations come later; what you get here is a straight price for the roadmap session.

Then, the roadmap session

A paid working session where the plan arrives: which agents fit which roles, which Add-ons to start with, and the order to roll them out. Yours to keep, whether we build it with you or you run it.

Anything missing, we build

If the roadmap points at something the marketplace doesn’t have yet, building it is part of the job, not a separate project to go and scope.

Start Your Business Roadmap →
Guided setup

Rather have us walk your team through it?

You can set this up yourself, and Archie is built for that. Plenty of owners would rather not, the first time through: we build the agents with you on the computer that will run them, connect accounts with your approval, and fine-tune after launch. The steps are on How It Works; the three costs below are the whole list.

Guided sessions

$250 a session, an hour each. A bigger setup takes more sessions, never a higher rate. We scope how many on the free call.

Archie

$99 a month or $999 a year, one plan covering every agent the team runs, with no seat count and separate from guided setup. Archie is in testing and not for sale yet. See where it stands →

The AI model

The agents run on the business’s own account with the AI company, pay-as-you-go and billed straight to you: typically a few dollars a month per person. Measured costs are on Pricing.
